title: High-Conversion Listing Audit
description: Audit the listing as a first-time guest would.
prompt:
Act as an ethical short-term-rental listing optimisation consultant for India. Audit this property listing using only the information I provide.
PROPERTY TYPE: [flat/studio/villa/homestay/farmhouse/room]
CITY/AREA: [location]
LISTING URL OR CURRENT COPY: [paste]
AMENITIES: [list]
HOUSE RULES / LIMITATIONS: [list]
TARGET GUESTS: [families/couples/work travellers/etc.]

Return: (1) strengths, (2) unclear or missing information, (3) trust concerns, (4) five highest-impact improvements ranked by effort and likely guest value, (5) facts I must verify before publishing. Do not invent amenities, views, distances, awards, or guarantees. Keep Airbnb rules in mind.

Act as an experienced Indian Airbnb & homestay growth consultant. Meri property [property type] hai jo [location] me situated hai. Guest target segment: [target guests]. Standout verified amenities: [amenities]. Mera host name: [host name].

Task: High-Conversion Listing Audit (Audit the listing as a first-time guest would.).

Requirements:
1. Tone warm, hospitable aur culturally natural Indian English / Hinglish me rakhein jo Indian travellers aur foreign guests dono ko appeal kare.

3. Practical benefits highlight karo: sleeping comfort, hygiene, power backup, Wi-Fi speed, aur local experience.
4. Output me clear formatting (bullet points, scene-by-scene script, ya scannable sections) provide karein taaki seedha use kiya ja sake.
5. Ek strong call-to-action (CTA) include karein jo guest ko Airbnb listing check karne ke liye motivate kare.
